caption: The drawing features a composition divided into three main vertical sections, separated by four large, twisted, green and red columns with ornate red and gold bases and capitals. In the central lower section, there is a crowned female figure dressed in blue and gold, holding a crowned child in red, both with halos, and a scepter with flowers. The left section shows a figure in grey and red, wearing a crown and holding a staff topped with a cross, standing next to green foliage. The right section depicts a figure in red and green, with a crown, holding a sun-shaped object in the right hand and a palm branch in the left, next to a grey tower and some plants. Above, the scene is framed by elaborate floral and leaf ornamentation in pink, red, green, black, and yellow, with swirling patterns and stylized flowers. The upper part of the drawing contains three red-robed figures with white pointed head coverings; one holds a large black cross, and all are surrounded by brown, yellow, and red swirling background motifs, and additional red flowers. The entire composition uses bold outlines, with prominent hues of red, blue, green, gold, brown, black, and pink.
title: Plate 21: Main Altarpiece: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
